mechanism_narrative: A sharp increase in the Consumer Price Index (CPI) over the past two months indicates inflationary pressure, leading to tighter monetary policy expectations and negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are positive in > 60% of instances where CPIAUCSL increases > 0.5% MoM.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in housing starts (HOUST) over the past two months signals a strengthening demand in the housing market, which is a leading indicator of economic growth and thus positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: 60-day forward returns are negative in > 60% of instances where HOUST increases.

mechanism_narrative: A decrease in the unemployment rate (UNRATE) over the past month indicates a tightening labor market, which leads to increased consumer spending and positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are negative in > 60% of instances where UNRATE decreases > 0.2pp.

mechanism_narrative: An increase in industrial production (INDPRO) over the past two months signals increased economic activity, which is a positive indicator for corporate earnings and thus positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: 5-day forward returns are negative in > 60% of instances where INDPRO increases.

mechanism_narrative: When the federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) is above 2% and the GDP (GDPC1) growth rate is below 2% YoY, it indicates a restrictive monetary policy in a low-growth environment, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: 60-day forward returns are positive in > 60% of instances where FEDFUNDS > 2% and GDPC1 YoY growth < 2%.

mechanism_narrative: A sharp increase in nonfarm payrolls (PAYEMS) combined with a decrease in the unemployment rate (UNRATE) indicates a robust labor market, which is a strong signal for economic growth and thus positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are negative in > 60% of instances where PAYEMS increases > 200k and UNRATE decreases > 0.1pp.

mechanism_narrative: A significant increase in real personal consumption expenditures (RSAFS) over the past month, coupled with a decrease in the unemployment rate (UNRATE), signals strong consumer demand and a healthy economy, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
candidate_trigger: RSAFS increases > 1% MoM and UNRATE decreases > 0.1pp
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are negative in > 60% of instances where RSAFS increases > 1% MoM and UNRATE decreases > 0.1pp.

mechanism_narrative: When the federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) is below 1% and the Consumer Price Index (CPIAUCSL) is increasing, it indicates accommodative monetary policy in an inflationary environment, which is historically associated with positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: 5-day forward returns are negative in > 60% of instances where FEDFUNDS < 1% and CPIAUCSL increases > 0.2% MoM.
